'''Water jets''' were a component of [[Keelkana-class attack submersible/Legends|''Keelkana''-class attack submersibles]]. Each [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] had two jets, which were located near their [[torpedo tube]]s.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
